scope: Read-only semantic audit of parent-executed paired controls; no tests, probes, lifecycle commands or project writes executed by this auditor.
selection: Input order shown below; later records with the same id supersede earlier records. Different insensitive ids remain visible and are not silently replaced.

limits: Behavioral sensitivity demonstrates the chosen assertions for bounded fixtures; it is not proof of unbounded host, filesystem or model behavior.
Role/equipment briefing controls establish emitted policy text; they do not establish future agent compliance.
Nested-empty normalization, host-shape rejection, concrete runner policy and obsolete effort-mode cleanup include preservation mutations and must not all be described as new historical repairs.

An exit1 alone is never accepted: shell arms were checked at their explicit assertion or traced terminal command, and each accepted typed test was checked at its intended value/presence/refusal assertion.
